name: tapora-proto-kit
description: Studio-grade interactive HTML prototypes of websites, web apps and iOS/Android apps, from first concept to handover: settle the concept on a visual board, design from scratch with decision gates, extend or tweak an existing prototype without design drift, and a regression QA kit with rolling baselines. Skill instructions are written in Vietnamese.

interface.shortDescription: Design, evolve and QA interactive HTML prototypes.
interface.longDescription: Settle the concept first on a visual board of three real concepts to pick or mix (sketch-to-concept), then build a website, web app, iOS/Android app, or a whole system such as an admin portal plus a customer app, from scratch as an interactive HTML prototype (sketch-to-site), with four decision gates across the two, extend it with new features without design drift (evolve-site), make small edits without ceremony (tweak-site), and run one full regression check before handover (handover-check). Includes a headless-browser QA kit with rolling baselines. Skill instructions are written in Vietnamese.
defaultPrompt: Lên concept cho website một quán cà phê, dùng sketch-to-concept.
Thiết kế website cho một quán cà phê, dùng sketch-to-site.
Thêm bộ lọc theo ngày vào trang đơn hàng của prototype.
Kiểm tổng prototype trước khi bàn giao.
